material_type.evidence: inferred: This dataset includes left ventricular (LV) myocardium from 34 human hearts – either non-failing (NF) or failing hearts.

sample_source.evidence: inferred: Transmural myocardial samples were dissected from the mid LV free wall below the papillary muscle.

inferred: Myocytes were isolated from 22 hearts (see method details below) for functional studies, including 6 normal and 7 cHyp, 9 failing transplants (all hearts with EF<50%, including 6 DCM, 1HCMpEF, 1 HCMrEF, 1 ICM).

sex.evidence: inferred: cHyp is defined by an indexed LV mass (LV mass/body surface area) above 115g/m2 in men and 95g/m2 in women.
